envWarning.intro: The database change already succeeded. Pluto could not write {variable} to your project's {file} file, so it will ask again next time unless you add it by hand:

setup.title: Setup Wizard
setup.why: It will be used to create your database structure. It won't be stored anywhere. That's a {promise}! 😉
setup.promiseTooltip: Click on the 'Technical details' button for more info
setup.technicalDetailsRequest: When you click "Next", a request to {route} will be made with the database password you provided. This API will then use this password to make a direct PostgreSQL connection to your Supabase database and run the SQL queries from this {files}.
setup.technicalDetailsStored: After the setup is complete, the password will NOT be stored or used for any other purpose.
setup.restartDescription: Saving your connection string writes it to .env. In development, that restarts the server automatically. The page will briefly show a reconnecting message — this is expected, not an error.
setup.reconnectedDescription: The server is back. Your database has been set up.
setup.failedDescription: Please check your password and try again.
setup.completeDescription: Your database has been set up successfully.
setup.doneDescription: Your database is ready. Create your admin account by signing up.

migrations.title: Migrations
migrations.banner: {count} layer needs a database migration | {count} layers need a database migration
migrations.upToDateDescription: No layer needs a database migration.
migrations.why: It is used once to open a direct PostgreSQL connection and run the pending layer schemas. It is then written to .env on the server, so future migrations need no prompt. It is never stored anywhere else, and never sent back to your browser.
migrations.restartDescription: Saving a new connection string writes it to .env. In development, that restarts the server automatically. The page will briefly show a reconnecting message — this is expected, not an error.
migrations.restartingDescription: Saving a new connection string restarts the dev server. Reconnecting…
migrations.reconnectingBanner: Saving a new connection string restarts the dev server. Reconnecting — this page will update on its own once it's back.
migrations.reconnectedAllApplied: The server is back. All migrations were applied.
migrations.reconnectedPending: The server is back. {count} layer(s) still pending — check above.
migrations.connectionRequired: A database connection string is required.
migrations.loadFailedDescription: This isn't the dev-server-restart case above — something else went wrong reading migration status. Check the server console, then try again.
